summary: A Lane Cove skin clinic appears to lose bookings to a free builder address, a homepage made of 2020 and 2021 blog posts and no online booking.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free SITE123 address, with a footer that says I BUILT MY SITE FOR FREE USING SITE123.
findings.cost: A free builder footer looks temporary for a clinic that sells skin treatments.
findings.fix: Your own domain and a branded footer.

findings.problem: The homepage appears to show blog posts dated 2020 and 2021 instead of your treatments and prices.
findings.cost: A visitor sees old posts and not what you offer, so they leave for a clinic that shows treatments.
findings.fix: Treatment pages with prices and results.

findings.problem: The page appears to be labelled Beauty Salon Sydney rather than a skin clinic.
findings.cost: Clients searching for laser and skin treatments may not find you under a salon label.
findings.fix: A clear title with your treatments and suburb.

findings.problem: No online booking and no WhatsApp appear, only two phone numbers and a gmail address.
findings.cost: Clients who want to book at night cannot, and they book where they can.
findings.fix: Online booking on the page and a WhatsApp button.
